name: Large gaps between sums of two squares
description: construct() -> [a,b], positive endpoints a<b<=maximum=10000000, b-a<=10000, both sums of two integer squares (zero is permitted). No interior integer may be a sum of two squares. Maximize b-a. Positive consecutive representable endpoints at most 10000000 and distance at most 10000, with zero allowed as one of the two squared integers. Every interior integer is checked. The optimum is 50 (9565544 to 9565594; OEIS A297350); this is a rediscovery task.
